data.subject: URGENT: wadding and zip deliveries delayed 7 days
data.body: Dear Merxa buying team, due to a dyeing-line breakdown at our Tongi plant, deliveries of CMP-WAD-01 (polyester wadding) and CMP-ZIP-01 (two-way zips) to Gazipur Outerwear Unit 1 (F-BD-01) and Narayanganj Outerwear Unit 2 (F-BD-02) will arrive 7 days later than planned. Garment ex-factory dates for all open puffer jacket orders will move by about one week. We apologise for the inconvenience. Meghna Trims Ltd, customer service.
